lines.label: B1
lines.reason: This is the fold from the plate (1) to long flange A (3), about 90 deg. In the perpendicular sections at 25, 50 and 75%, the label point sits on the outer-skin apex, 0.20-0.23 mm from the nearest point, with the inner skin about 1.5 mm inward. The apex zone runs from t = -1 to 40 mm and the label covers t = 0 to 39.9 mm. The extruded/countersunk hole on flange A sits above the fold. At the 50% section the inner skin shows the hole wall, but the outer apex stays continuous, so this is one line.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: This is the fold from the plate (1) to end flange C (6), about 90 deg. The sections at 25, 50 and 75% put the label on the outer apex, 0.07-0.23 mm off. Apex-normal points run from t = 0 to 25.7 mm, which matches the label. Past t = 26 mm there is a step and an unfolded plate-level tab with only a perimeter edge, not a fold, so the line rightly stops at the end of flange C.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: This is the fold from the plate (2) to flange B (5), which is folded back to about 129 deg (included angle about 51 deg). The sections at 25, 50 and 75% put the label on the outer apex, 0.16-0.20 mm off, with the inner skin 1.5 mm in. The fold apex spans t = 0 to about 34.8 mm, which matches the label. At t = -4 to 0 the flange B lip overhangs a plate relief notch and has no apex skin. At t = 38-40 there is the edge of flange C, which is not part of this fold.
